newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Pharma issues 168 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: China Pharma issues 168 mln new shares.

text.p: China Pharmaceutical Enterprise & Investment Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it would issue 168 million new shares to its controlling shareholder Shijiazhuang Pharmaceutical Group Co Ltd at HK$1.2768 per share.

The company said in a statement that Shijiazhuang Pharmaceutical had agreed to place the same number of existing shares, or 19.75 percent of China Pharmaceutical's existing share capital, to independent investors at HK$1.33 per share.

The new share issue would raise net proceeds of about HK$214 million, half of which would be used to finance the possible acquisition of businesses manufacturing pharmaceutical products and the balance for working capital.
"The company has commenced preliminary discussions but they are at an early stage," China Pharmaceutical said.
China Pharmaceutical said Cheung Siu Ying, an executive director of the company, had also agreed to place 10 million existing shares at HK$1.33 per share and would not take up any new shares.
Shijiazhuang Pharmaceutical's stake in China Pharmaceutical would fall to 58.33 percent of the enlarged issued share capital after the transactions compared with 69.85 percent now.
Trading in China Pharmaceutical shares was suspended on Tuesday and is due to resume on Wednesday. The stock fell HK$0.01 on Monday to close at HK$1.43.
